annotations.title: Count India Central Government Working Days

description:
Use this when you need an auditable 2026 central-government count and can specify the office scope. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when you need a state/UT, bank, employer, school, exchange or exact outside-Delhi local optional calendar.
What it computes: Counts 2026 central-government baseline working and non-working dates while preserving Gazetted and Restricted event classes.
Example user requests: Count Delhi central-government working days from 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-31.
Inputs: start_date (date); end_date (date); office_scope (enum); include_start_date (boolean, optional); include_end_date (boolean, optional).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2026-10-01","end_date":"2026-10-31","office_scope":"delhi_new_delhi","include_start_date":true,"include_end_date":true}
Outputs: normalized_start_date, normalized_end_date, working_days, non_working_days, calendar_days_counted, gazetted_holidays_counted, restricted_holidays_available, territory, territory_name, office_scope, office_scope_name, is_guaranteed_non_working_day, day_type, restricted_holiday_available, calendar_scope, rest_day_policy, restricted_holiday_policy, selection_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: for each included date: working_days += selected status.is_working_day
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/india-central-working-days-between with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/india-central-working-days-between.md

office_scope.description: Required scope: delhi_new_delhi or outside_delhi. State/UT holiday calendars are not represented by this package.

name: count_india_central_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

day_type.description: Weekly rest day, gazetted holiday, restricted option or regular weekday.

is_guaranteed_non_working_day.description: True for the weekly baseline or an applicable gazetted holiday.

restricted_holiday_available.description: Whether a restricted-holiday option is listed on the date.

restricted_holiday_policy.description: Restricted and locally selected optional-holiday rule.

selection_policy.description: Whether local optional selection is required.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Count India Central Government Working Days
